info.name: discord-dms-service
info.description: Endpoints of discord-dms-service 0.5.0 (Team 19, Topic 3: Student ID, Please; Laboratory 4). Run the folders top to bottom, or use the Collection Runner: later requests depend on ids captured from earlier responses. Business requests go through the API Gateway (baseUrl http://localhost:8080) and send the API key from the apiKey variable as Authorization: Bearer (set apiKey to one of the keys in GATEWAY_API_KEYS). Discord is simulated: recipient 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000403 does not accept direct messages, and any random recipient receives its message on the first attempt. Get Failed Notification waits 3 s for the delivery worker. The Event Delivery folder publishes the consumed events to the Message Broker (brokerUrl), which delivers them to the service over gRPC; POST /internal/events is retired. The Chat folder asks the gateway for a chat ticket through POST /ws/negotiate: open the url it returns with a WebSocket client before expiresAt to join the chat directly on discord-dms-service. The Internal diagnostics folder reads GET /metrics and GET /internal/logs on the instance itself (internalBaseUrl); these routes are not public Gateway routes.

item.name: Event Delivery through the Message Broker
item.description: Plays one shift through the Message Broker (brokerUrl, its HTTP port 8091 on the Compose network; publish or forward it for Postman). Each request publishes the event envelope of docs/MESSAGE_BROKER_CONTRACT.md in the CPR, and the broker delivers one copy to one discord-dms-service instance with gRPC ServiceEndpoint.Deliver. The instance answers COMMITTED only after the notifications and the eventId are stored in Redis in one transaction. The broker answers 202 before that delivery, so the notifications are checked in the logs: docker compose logs discord-dms-service discord-dms-service-replica | grep postman- shows one DELIVER line per event, under its X-Request-Id, and the publish of the same event again is COMMITTED as a duplicate that queues nothing.
